staticText: Private descriptive-statistics worksheet for finite numeric datasets. Invalid tokens stop calculation instead of being silently discarded. It reports sample and population variance and standard deviation, inclusive linear-interpolation quartiles, coefficient of variation only when the mean is non-zero, and adjusted Fisher-Pearson skewness only when sample size and spread permit it. CV is not a universal quality threshold. Other textbooks and software may use different quartile or skewness conventions. Summary exports omit the raw dataset.
